title: ACTIVE RELOAD ON A CONTROLLER NEXT TO A BOX
why: On a controller X is the only reload button, and the X press picks search or reload once: with any box, body, door or forge in reach it always picked search, and the active reload reads only the reload key. So a second X press in the sweet spot of a reload searched the box instead of landing the bonus, and player 2, always on a controller, could never land an active reload near anything searchable while a keyboard player could. Proven in headless Chromium by driving the real pad poll with a fake controller: with nothing near, X in the sweet spot gives the bonus; with a box in reach it gave xMode KeyE, no bonus, and a search. Now, only while the reload is inside the sweet spot, X counts as the reload press; a downed teammate in reach still takes the revive, and X earlier or later in the reload still searches.
now: On a controller, pressing X in the sweet spot of a reload now lands the active reload even standing next to a box.
